objective: R2D-03 quirurgico: obtener columnas reales de todos los candidatos de almacenes existentes. Solo lectura; una consulta; sin POS LIVE, Mongo, DDL ni DML.

queries.name: warehouse_columns
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(c.object_id) AS schema_name, OBJECT_NAME(c.object_id) AS object_name, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) AS data_type, c.max_length, c.precision, c.scale, c.is_nullable, c.is_identity FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id IN (OBJECT_ID('dbo.Inventario_Almacenes'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_Almacenes'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.Almacenes'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.Compras_Almacenes_Sync'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.Inventarios_Almacenes_Sync')) ORDER BY object_name,c.column_id;
